gradient_help: baseline_gradient applies only to Baseline (based on a reference day); baseline_gradient_default is kept for restoring colors. Classic uses the selected color scheme, with the median active-day score for workload and recorded time. Each gradient point has workload_ratio (1 = 85% of the reference score), hsl [hue 0-360, saturation 0-100%, lightness 0-100%], and opacity (0-100%). Points must be ordered by ratio. Below starts at 0 and ends at 1; above starts at 1. Colors interpolate in RGB, with an intentional jump at the target; the final color is held for higher activity. Save to refresh. The reference date stays white; empty days stay uncolored.
